summary: T06 calendar-multiget implementation verified: all 3 acceptance criteria met by passing tests (data+ETags for authorized hrefs, per-item 404 for missing/foreign hrefs without failing the 207 report, href count bounded at 1000). Full backend suite, fmt, and clippy all pass.
important_context: Multiget only exposes timed non-recurring events; all-day (T13) and recurring (T14) events return per-item 404 by design.
href_within_collection enforces same-collection scoping; cross-user calendar access is blocked at the dav_calendar handler before multiget runs.
